interpretation.startup: The startup winner is the harness with the lowest median fresh-process metric; this does not measure an active agent session.
interpretation.task: Task resource comparisons are descriptive because model-provider behavior, tool use, delegation, and task completion differ. Luna-max solo comparisons are the closest matched task subset.
interpretation.fx: fx uses its native zai/glm-5.2 model and has no comparable delegation arm in this CLI version.
interpretation.grok: Grok Build task coverage is quota-censored after the initial successful request and is not used for stable repeated-task ranking.
